title: Best Social Media Strategy Consultants (2026): A Plan That Fits
description: How to hire a social media strategy consultant for an audit, content plan and channel priorities: deliverables, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Social media strategy consultants help you decide what to post, where and why, without running your accounts day to day. A typical project includes an audit of your current channels, audience research, content pillars, a posting rhythm and simple measures of success. Good strategy fits your team's time and your customers' habits. It goes wrong when advice is generic, recommends every platform at once or ignores what has already worked for you. This guide helps you get a social plan you can actually run.

faq.q: Is strategy the same as social media management?
faq.a: No. Strategy creates the plan; management executes it. Some consultants offer both.
The ones where your customers spend time and where you can create content consistently. A good consultant recommends priorities, not everything.
Often an audit, audience notes, content pillars, example posts, a calendar template and success measures.

faq.q: How long does a strategy last?
faq.a: Usually a few months, with a review based on results.
Read-only access to analytics helps. Avoid sharing passwords.
